reader.requirement: At --std 85 a relation between two index-names (of the same or different tables, of any element size, nested levels included) yields the result of comparing their occurrence numbers, never their implementor displacement values.
reader.edition-search: grep 'DialectLevel|Edition' over ExpressionBinder.cs (only ctx.Edition as the diagnostic sink and position scope), 'Edition|Version|Dialect' over ConditionRenderer.cs (the two hits are the character-comparison arms, not reached by a numeric index relation). FieldOperand binds an index-name as BoundComputedOperand(BoundIndexRef), the occurrence number, and the relation renders through RenderNumericRelational with no edition switch.
